description: Map the attack surface of the user's own codebase by inventorying every entry point (HTTP routes, webhooks, CLI arguments, message consumers, file and environment input, scheduled jobs), the authentication and authorization applied to each, and the data an attacker controls, as a red-team reconnaissance step for authorized security testing. Use when the user asks to map the attack surface, list entry points, find unauthenticated endpoints, or prepare a penetration test of their own application. Do not use for scanning or probing hosts or third-party systems, for finding specific vulnerabilities in code (use agent-kit:security-audit), or for designing new features (use agent-kit:threat-model); this skill reads code and does not send network traffic.
